unit: one fresh subject on one task, arm, and repetition

blocking.requirement: Every completed block contains each of the four arms exactly once.

ordering_algorithm.name: SHA256_SORT_V1
ordering_algorithm.input_frame: seed UTF-8 + NUL + task_id UTF-8 + NUL + configuration_id UTF-8 + NUL + decimal repetition UTF-8 + NUL + arm_id UTF-8
ordering_algorithm.order: ascending raw SHA-256 digest bytes with arm_id as the collision tiebreaker

preregistration_requirements: random seed commitment published before subject launch
sealed arm mapping retained outside subject context
